name: milan-dwn-node
description: MILAN standalone Decentralized Web Node (DWN) — a persistent, authenticated DWN storage service (records, media, database snapshots) speaking the MILAN DWN HTTP API, backed by the DIF/TBD dwn-sdk-js reference engine. Deploys independently (GCP) so user data lives in a real DWN node decoupled from the app server.
